note: Realistic set, approved by Lucky 2026-11-24. Generated on Higgsfield: seed_audio (44.1 kHz wav) for effects, elevenlabs_music_v2_5 (4 s, instrumental) for the music stings. Each sound is one or more pieces: a take is generated from `prompt`, the part from..to seconds is placed at `at` seconds (3 ms fade in, 8 ms fade out, optional gainDb), the mix is optionally high-passed twice at highpassHz (removes the sub boom Seed Audio adds to punches), cut to `keep` seconds and faded out over the last `fade` seconds. That mix is zdroj_art/sfx_raw/<name>.mp3; tools/sfx/sfx_process.mjs turns it into assets/sfx/<name>.mp3.
